sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
3. This is an application for grant of interim bail to the petitioner.

4. The petitioner is an accused in connection with Bhubaneswar Cyber Crime and Economic Office Wing P.S. Case No.119 of 2023 corresponding to C.T. Case No.1927 of 2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 420/467 of the IPC pending in the Court of the learned S.D.J.M.,
Bhubaneswar.

entities.text: Bhubaneswar Cyber Crime and Economic Office Wing P.S. Case No.119 of 2023
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the wife of the petitioner is at advance stage and her expected date of delivery is 21.10.2024 and nobody is in her family to look after her health except the petitioner.
The wife of the petitioner is eagerly waiting to see her husband for moral support.
He further submitted that the condition of the wife of the petitioner is deteriorating from day to day, but no active member in her family is there to take care of the further treatment.
Therefore, the presence of the petitioner is highly essential.
Hence, he prays that the petitioner may be released on interim bail for a period of three months from the date of his release.

6. Mr. Ragada, learned Additional Government Advocate, on instruction, submits a report dated 08.10.2024 has been received from the A.C.P., CC & P.S., Bhubaneswar-UPD, which reads as under:

sentences.text: "With due respect in citing the above reference and Subject, I am to state that on 08.10.2024 I received the letter (T) WhatsApp.

As per the direction of the Hon'ble Court VHF message has been sent to IIC Brahmagiri P.S. to obtain the genuineness of medical certificate (Report) and present health condition of Madhusmita Behera,
W/o- Prakash Chandra Swain @ Gugun (Petitioner) a filed in the above BLAPL No.30573 of 2024.
As the petitioner's wife Madhusmita Behera is saying at Brahmagiri, PUri and she got her health treatment at DHH, Puri.
Received information from IIC Brahmagiri and IIC Sadar Puri that wife of the petitioner is pregnant and expecting her delivery on this October."

7. Considering the aforementioned and the report dated 08.10.2024 and in view of the medical urgency of the petitioner, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on interim bail for a period of two month from the date of his release.

8. Therefore, the petitioner be released on interim bail for a period of two months from the date of his release by the learned Court in seisin over the matter in connection with the aforementioned case on such terms and conditions as it may deem just and proper.
After completion of the interim bail period of two months, the petitioner shall surrender before the learned Court below.
Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of the interim bail.

9. In so far as regular bail plea of the petitioner is concerned the counsel for the petitioner seeks liberty to withdraw the same to renew the prayer before the court below after he surrenders on completion of the interim bail period.
10. This I.A. stands disposed of.
11. The petitioner may use the downloaded copy of this order from the Official website of the High Court, as the urgent certified copy cannot be issued due to the ensuing Durga Puja vacation.
(S.S. Mishra) Judge amit Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack.
